question: Will the next published update to the Metaculus AI Forecasting Benchmark leaderboard (after 2026-07-27) be topped by a multi-agent ensemble approach rather than a single-model forecaster?
resolution_criteria: Check Metaculus's published AI Forecasting Benchmark / FutureEval results for the next leaderboard update after today. Resolves YES if the top entry is documented as using ensembling across multiple models or multiple independent research passes; NO if it's a single model/single pass.
reasoning: Ensembling and multi-pass research are cheap to add on top of any base forecaster and have a strong track record of beating single-shot predictions in both classical forecasting and LLM-based settings; several community Metaculus bots already use ensemble/multi-agent approaches, suggesting the field has already converged this direction.
